scope.description: Every production source location that owns an authoritative persistence ingress, egress, or value carried across one. Test and benchmark directories are deliberately out of scope: they may construct historical or malformed bytes, but cannot define a production storage spelling. Endpoint allowances and direct-dependency classifications are sensitive reviewed policy, not an automatic serializer safety proof: this gate detects accidental dependency/endpoint drift rather than malicious misclassification.
